title: Revit Working Library - Data Export and Analytics

entries.name: Standard schedule source model
working_guidance: govern a canonical schedule source separately from project models
verify fields, filters, sorting and formatting before distribution
do not alter the canonical schedule source ad hoc

entries.name: Schedule injection workflow
working_guidance: prefer governed automation for inserting standard schedules into project models
verify injected schedules match the canonical source
manual insertion should be treated as an exception where automation is the target state

entries.name: Schedule extraction workflow
working_guidance: use stable output naming and destination
verify file existence, timestamp, non-zero size, headers and row-count plausibility

entries.name: Analytics consumption
working_guidance: align report refresh cadence with source export cadence
validate row/column alignment between source schedule and analytics table

working_rules: The Revit model or governed schedule source remains authoritative for model data unless another source is explicitly designated.
An analytics dataset is a downstream representation, not automatically a new authority.
Manual one-off exports should not silently replace a governed repeatable pipeline.

provenance.migration_note: Schedule injection/extraction and analytics workflow retained as non-authoritative working knowledge. Source organization and storage-platform assumptions generalized.
